question: Does the Digital Omnibus change when Chapters I and II of the AI Act apply?
sub_questions: What date does the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) specify for the application of Chapters I and II?
Does the Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) amend the application date of Chapters I and II of the AI Act, and if so, what is the new date?

question: The Commission's GPAI scope guidelines describe an open-source exemption from Article 53(1)(a)-(b). Which article of the AI Act's own text, as also captured in the Service Desk's Article 53 page, establishes this exemption, and what condition removes it?
sub_questions: What does Article 53 of the AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) state about an exemption from the obligations in Article 53(1)(a) and (b) for providers of general-purpose AI models released under a free and open-source licence?
What condition under Article 53 of the AI Act causes a general-purpose AI model to no longer qualify for the open-source exemption from Article 53(1)(a)-(b)?
What does the AI Act Service Desk's summary page for Article 53 say about the open-source exemption from Article 53(1)(a)-(b) and the condition that removes it?

question: A provider wants to know whether their chatbot needs both an Article 50(1) 'you are talking to an AI' disclosure and a GDPR Article 13/14 information notice. Do these two obligations serve the same purpose, or are they distinct requirements that could both apply to the same system?
sub_questions: What does Article 50(1) of the AI Act require regarding disclosure to natural persons that they are interacting with an AI system, and what purpose does this obligation serve?
What information must be provided to a data subject under Articles 13 and 14 of GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679), and what purpose does this information notice serve?

Can the Article 50(1) AI Act transparency disclosure obligation and the GDPR Article 13/14 information notice obligation both apply to the same AI system, or does satisfying one obligation also satisfy the other?
